build.name: configure+make (WAM->native bootstrap)
build.cmd: ./configure >/dev/null 2>&1 && make -s 2>&1 | tail -3; find . -name gprolog -type f | head -1

runs.name: append/3 by SLD resolution
runs.cmd: G=$(find $BODY/upstream/tree -name gprolog -type f | head -1); echo "append(X,[c],[a,b,c]), write(X), nl, halt." | $G --quiet 2>&1 | tail -4

notes: GNU Prolog compiles clauses to WAM then native; the append query exercises unification + backtracking. If the WAM bootstrap fails under a modern gcc, the receipt records it BUILDS_NOT_RUN/BROKEN_UPSTREAM rather than being weakened.
